stemMd: A linear peptide containing six amino-acid residues is formed from free amino acids by condensation. How many water molecules are released in forming its backbone?
explanationMd: Joining six initially separate units into one linear chain requires five peptide bonds. Each condensation forms one bond and releases one water molecule; the number is therefore 6 minus 1.

distractorRationale.a: Five separate links must be formed.
distractorRationale.e: Water is released per peptide bond, not per functional group counted twice.
distractorRationale.b: Each peptide bond joins adjacent residues, not disjoint pairs only.
distractorRationale.d: A linear chain has one fewer links than residues.
